name: Review table shows flagged rows with reasons

planSteps.description: Navigate to the upload page: http://127.0.0.1:8501/upload

Set the file input to a file named 'sales.csv' whose UTF-8 content is exactly:
Order ID,Order Date,Customer Name,Region,Qty.,Revenue
ORD-1,09/01/2026,Acme Inc,north,2,"$1,240.00"
ORD-2,31/09/2026,Beta Co,south,3,not available
Click the primary button 'Continue to column mapping →', keep the suggested mappings unchanged, then click 'Confirm mapping & continue →'.
On the Processing page click 'Run cleaning & validation' and wait for the results to appear.
The review page heading 'Rows that need your attention' is visible together with an info line '1 rows flagged out of 3 total rows'.
A table shows the flagged row with a reason containing 'Invalid date' and 'Invalid amount' (the value 'not available').
Two download buttons labeled 'Download as .xlsx' and 'Download as .csv' are visible, plus a primary button 'Continue to download center →'.
